name: peer-chat-bg
description: Equal background coding peers in Claude Code and Codex, without agterm: durable questions and delivery receipts, shared design and build protocols, accepted file ownership, frozen cross-review targets and empirical acceptance checks. Native peers remain in their host runtime. An opt-in SessionStart hook (first line of `~/.claude/peer-chat.mode` = `bg`) starts every interactive session in peer mode: it injects a tiered directive only, and no peer starts before the first use.
